description_en: Queries the contextual logs of a specified log
description_zh: 调用GetContextLogs接口查询指定日志前（上文）后（下文）的若干条日志
kebab_example: aliyun sls get-context-logs --project ali-test-project --logstore test-logstore --pack-id 85C897C740352DC6-808 --pack-meta 2_MTY1NTcwNTUzODY5MTY0MDk1Mg==_3_0 --back-lines 10 --forward-lines 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetContextLogs

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the log group to which the start log belongs
parameters.help_zh: 起始日志所属的LogGroup的唯一身份标识
parameters.name: pack_id

parameters.help_en: The unique context identifier of the start log in the log group
parameters.help_zh: 起始日志在对应LogGroup内的唯一上下文结构标识
parameters.name: pack_meta

parameters.help_en: The number of logs that you want to obtain and are generated before the generation time of the start log. Valid values: `(0,100]`
parameters.help_zh: 指定起始日志往前（上文）的日志条数，取值范围为`(0,100]`
parameters.name: back_lines

parameters.help_en: The number of logs that you want to obtain and are generated after the generation time of the start log. Valid values: `(0,100]`
parameters.help_zh: 指定起始日志往后（下文）的日志条数，取值范围为`(0,100]`
parameters.name: forward_lines

back_lines.description_en: The number of logs that are generated before the generation time of the start log
back_lines.description_zh: 向前查询到的日志条数
back_lines.title_zh: 向前查询到的日志条数。

forward_lines.description_en: The number of logs that are generated after the generation time of the start log
forward_lines.description_zh: 向后查询到的日志条数
forward_lines.title_zh: 向后查询到的日志条数。

items.description_en: The logs that are returned. The logs are arranged in contextual order. If no contextual logs are found based on the specified start log, this parameter is empty
items.description_zh: 获取到的日志，按上下文顺序排列。当根据指定起始日志查询不到上下文日志时，此参数为空

logs.title_zh: 获取到的日志，按上下文顺序排列。当根据指定起始日志查询不到上下文日志时，此参数为空。

progress.description_en:
Indicates whether the query and analysis results are complete. Valid values:

Complete: The query is successful, and the complete query and analysis results are returned.

Incomplete: The query is successful, but the query and analysis results are incomplete. To obtain the complete results, you must repeat the request
progress.description_zh:
查询的结果是否完整。

Complete：查询已经完成，返回结果为完整结果。
Incomplete：查询已经完成，返回结果为不完整结果，需要重复请求以获得完整结果
progress.title_zh:
查询的结果是否完整。
Complete：查询已经完成，返回结果为完整结果。
Incomplete：查询已经完成，返回结果为不完整结果，需要重复请求以获得完整结果。

total_lines.description_en: The total number of logs that are returned. The logs include the start log that is specified in the request
total_lines.description_zh: 返回的总日志条数，包含请求参数中所指定的起始日志
total_lines.title_zh: 返回的总日志条数，包含请求参数中所指定的起始日志。
